notes.title: Update Version 3.2.1
notes.content:
Alright, officers, listen up! We've got a new update for [b]The Meowfficer[/b], focusing on making your missions even better:

[b]Key Updates:
[/b]- Sound Fixes: Addressed issues where some sound effects weren't playing correctly.
- Item Pickup: Picking up items is now consistently done with the "E" key.
- Quest Tracker Added: A new quest tracker has been implemented to help you stay on mission.
- Battle Restarts: Dying in every battle will now restart you at the beginning of that fight, not the entire scene.

Thanks for your ongoing support and feedback. These changes are now live – jump back in and continue your investigations!
